editorial.blurb: New Great Wall BBQ serves up expertly roasted meats and steamed buns in Chinatown, with a kitchen that takes allergies seriously.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server about the sesame sauce to accompany the roasted duck—it's a worker-recommended pairing that elevates the dish, and the staff are attentive to allergen concerns if you flag them upfront.

topDishes.note: Liquid-fat rendering with delicious skin and seasoning; pairs beautifully with sesame sauce
Delicious and excellent value for group dining
